description: This file implements splay tree operations specific to curl's internal data structures, including splaying, insertion, removal, and getting the best-fit node. It is part of curl's internal utilities for managing sorted data efficiently.

methods.name: struct:Curl_tree * Curl_splay(struct curltime i,struct Curl_tree * t)
methods.description: Performs splaying operation to bring a node with a specific key to the root, or the closest node if exact match isn't found.

methods.name: struct:Curl_tree * Curl_splayinsert(struct curltime i,struct Curl_tree * t,struct Curl_tree * node)
methods.description: Inserts a new node into the splay tree based on its key, maintaining splay tree properties and handling duplicates via linked list of nodes with same key.

methods.name: struct:Curl_tree * Curl_splaygetbest(struct curltime i,struct Curl_tree * t,struct Curl_tree ** removed)
methods.description: Finds and removes the best-fit (smallest not larger than the given key) node from the splay tree.

methods.name: int Curl_splayremove(struct Curl_tree * t,struct Curl_tree * removenode,struct Curl_tree ** newroot)
methods.description: Removes a specified node from the splay tree, updating tree structure accordingly.

ctags.name: Curl_splaygetbest
ctags.signature: (struct curltime i,struct Curl_tree * t,struct Curl_tree ** removed)

ctags.signature: (struct curltime i,struct Curl_tree * t,struct Curl_tree * node)
